## Report

**Issue:** `requests.get` always sent a `Content-Length` header (e.g. `Content-Length: 0` on bodyless GETs), which made servers like amazon.com return 503.

**Cause** (in `requests/models.py`, `PreparedRequest.prepare_content_length`): the very first line unconditionally set `self.headers['Content-Length'] = '0'` — even when `body is None`, as in every GET/H
